saved mask (C7) comes from stage3 mhwdays computed in C6. C6 builds day-of-year thresholds from the baseline extract read in C3, using pools, Hazen q90, day-60 fill and circular 31-day smoothing. Only thrS at target doys 153-244 is used, so the smoothing span (doys 138-259) plus the ±5-day pools reaches baseline dates May 12–Sep 20 of each year.
